name: @epoch/supervision
description: Epoch Delivery Supervision kernel (W043) — policy-driven supervision of ProgramOfWork and DeliveryRecord state (USL1.0/SD1.0, binding): planned-vs-actual monitoring; critical-path and prerequisite checks (a typed CPM traversal that OBSERVES the W036 dependency graph — the schedule authority STAYS in ProgramOfWork, re-schedule attempts are typed re-schedule-rejected); acquisition/lead-time risk checks over W037-shaped lead-time observation inputs; consumption/cost anomaly checks as typed threshold rules over the W036 foldDeliveryActuals shapes (magnitude + breach class); verification failures (W036 VerificationGate + W038-shaped issue records surface as findings, never gate mutations); unresolved high-impact unknown detection over W036 DecisionImpact-material info-requests past their freshness requirements. Supervision is READ-ONLY over delivery state: every check is a pure function of sealed inputs to content-addressed, deterministic, replay-safe findings (due/late/drifted/blocked) carrying W006-convention provenance. Procurement/execution-tracking inputs arrive as OPAQUE typed references with devDep compile-time parity (the W037 kernel-parity pattern). NO persistence, NO UI, NO provider vocabulary, NO external providers (synthetic schedules only).
